title: Show mode
notes: New: Show mode. Play the show itself, episode by episode, across all six seasons (124 episodes). Choose it on the How do you want to play screen.

Every episode opens with its title and what happens in it, plus a main challenge and side challenges that mirror the episode. Whoever you play gets their own version, and the show's characters are pulled in when the story has them around.
Finish challenges for up to three stars an episode. Credits show how you did, with a 'Next time on Nashville' teaser. Misses have soft, story-fitting consequences.
Every season ends with a report card. Ace one to unlock a special outfit. Track every episode in More → Show mode.
